address: 280/23 Hoang Dieu Street, Nam Duong Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: This 30+-year-old no-frills shop at the very end of an alley serves a concise menu of crispy pancakes known as bánh xèo, alongside skewered pork, grilled meat and noodles. Everything comes with fresh herbs, pickled papaya, cucumber and strips of eggplant. Feel free to customise your own rice paper pancake with meat to order and condiments on the table. The minced pork peanut sauce dip is a must....
